subject: Mutual action plan: security acceptance deadlines, evidence playbook, and DPA timing
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@finalyze.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Roberto Silva <r.silva@finalyze.com>, procurement@finalyze.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & security evidence — target close dates

Diego / Marissa — thanks for taking this on. Quick context: Finalyze is running a timeboxed POC with the goal of completing technical validation by 2029-06-14 and execution (contract signature + procurement) by 2029-06-28. Procurement asked that security/compliance gating be captured in a mutual action plan so stakeholders have clear owners and deadlines.

Top asks from our side: 
- Full SOC 2 evidence (Type II) or attestation availability and owner
- SIG/CAIQ status and expected completion date
- DPA redline & DocuSign timeline (procurement prefers sign-off by 2029-06-07)
- Data retention / residency specifics for US and EU customers (tokenization/embeddings logs, audit logs, backups)

I've attached our SIG template (Finalyze_SIG_template_v1.xlsx) that we prefer to use as the questionnaire baseline. Can you confirm whether Redwood will: 
1) provide an SOC 2 Type II report (latest date/version),
2) complete SIG answers or provide point owners for outstanding items, and
3) share a DPA draft we can route to legal?

If we can get a proposed MPA with milestones by EOD Tue 2029-05-21, procurement can schedule DocuSign for the DPA and align internal legal review.

Appreciate it — looking to keep this tight.

Best,
Maya Patel
Head of Security Programs
Finalyze

Attached: Finalyze_SIG_template_v1.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@finalyze.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security evidence — target close dates

Maya — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can meet the deadlines with a focused playbook. High-level response and ownership below; I attached a proposed MPA timeline (redwood-mpa-proposed-timeline-2029-05-21.xlsx).

Summary commitments (short form):
- SOC 2 Type II: we will provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (audit completed Q4 2028). Owner: Jonas Weber. Deliverable: PDF report + control narrative excerpts by 2029-05-24.
- SIG/CAIQ: Redwood will complete the SIG spreadsheet with answers for the 120+ applicable controls and mark items needing customer-specific configuration. Owner: Marissa Cole. Deliverable: completed SIG workbook (first pass) by 2029-05-27.
- DPA: Kimberly will circulate Redwood's standard DPA with a limited redline for your legal team. Owner: Kimberly Park. Target DocuSign send by 2029-06-03 to support procurement's 2029-06-07 sign target.
- Data retention/residency: short summary — default logs (token-level metadata and operational logs) retained for 90 days in hosted mode; audit logs and billing traces retained for 3 years for enterprise customers by contract; EU residency available for customer workloads upon request, with export controls and region-specific SLA. Owner for details: Diego (operational), Jonas (technical evidence). Deliverable: short data lifecycle note by 2029-05-22.

Next steps: I propose a 30-minute sync to align owners and confirm outstanding SIG items on Fri 2029-05-24 at 10:00 PT. If that works, I can send a calendar invite.

Quote of your original message below for thread context.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@finalyze.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Roberto Silva <r.silva@finalyze.com>, procurement@finalyze.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security evidence — target close dates

Diego — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft timeline. A couple of clarifications from procurement and security: 

1) DocuSign window — procurement wants the DPA executed no later than 2029-06-07. If Kimberly can push a DocuSign envelope by 2029-06-03 that will work. Please confirm whether the DPA includes standard data residency and deletion rights (we may require explicit contractual language for EU data subjects).

2) Data retention specifics — for the POC we need confirmation on: 
   - whether embeddings or conversational content are stored persistently beyond the 90-day default (we need a firm answer on token retention policy),
   - how long audit logs (user access, admin changes) are retained and whether those can be exported on request,
   - backups and snapshot retention windows for private deployments (we assume longer retention — need numbers).

3) SIG/CAIQ completion — if possible, can you mark items that will require engineering changes vs policy answers (we want to know which require product changes to accept).

Procurement: Roberto will need the DPA draft and a short statement of data lifecycle for the SOW.

If you can confirm the above by Thu 2029-05-23 EOD, we can keep the POC / contract cadence intact.

Thanks,
Maya
Head of Security Programs
Finalyze

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@finalyze.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security evidence — target close dates

Maya / Roberto — following up with concrete deliverables and owners; attaching the SOC 2 report and a DPA redline draft for initial review. See attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2028.pdf and DPA_redline_draft_2029-05-22.docx.

Deliverable breakdown: 
- SOC 2 Type II (Q4 2028): attached full PDF + extracted control narratives for common questions (owner Jonas). Delivery: attached now.
- SIG/CAIQ workbook: I will run the first pass and flag engineering-impact items as "product change required" (expected first pass complete 2029-05-27). Workplan: Marissa to complete answers for policy/config items; Jonas to triage any questions that require product work.
- DPA redline: Kimberly has circulated the redline in the attached docx. Kimberly, can you confirm whether DocuSign envelope can be created on 2029-06-03?
- Data lifecycle summary: See short section below (I put in the MPA sheet as well): 
    * Hosted (default): ephemeral token data — retained for 90 days; aggregated telemetry and billing traces retained for 3 years.
    * Dedicated/Private: retention windows negotiable by contract; typical enterprise baseline is 3 years for audit logs and 7 years archival option on request.
    * EU Residency: available — customer workloads can be pinned to eu-west regions; deletion/export rights included in DPA with standard export timelines (30–90 days depending on data type).

Action items: 
- Kimberly: create DocuSign envelope for DPA on 2029-06-03 (target).
- Jonas: publish control excerpts and SOC 2 narrative by 2029-05-24 (done — attached).
- Marissa: SIG first-pass by 2029-05-27.
- Diego: coordinate a technical sync 2029-05-24 10:00 PT to review product-impact items.

Quote of earlier thread below.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2028.pdf; DPA_redline_draft_2029-05-22.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@finalyze.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & security evidence — target close dates

Maya / team — following the sync and the artifacts Marissa attached, here's a concise acceptance checklist to close the security gating items in the MPA. Please confirm acceptance or flag exceptions by EOD 2029-06-04.

Acceptance checklist (Redwood -> Finalyze):
- SOC 2: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2028.pdf provided. Finalyze acceptance: confirm control narrative answers sufficient for design/operational questions.
- SIG/CAIQ: first-pass workbook (Marissa) to be shared 2029-05-27; items marked "product change required" will carry a separate ETA and will not block POC unless they affect authentication/data-in-transit.
- DPA: DPA_redline_draft_2029-05-22.docx is the starting point. Kimberly will send DocuSign by 2029-06-03.
- Data retention/residency: short lifecycle note provided in MPA. For POC: token data will not be accessible to human reviewers and is retained 90 days; if Finalyze requires shorter retention for POC we can configure a 30-day retention window for the trial environment.

Proposed follow-up: final review call Wed 2029-06-05 to confirm outstanding SIG items and closing criteria for the POC. If Finalyze confirms DPA sign by 2029-06-07 and SOC 2 acceptance by 2029-06-04, we can proceed to contract execution on the 2029-06-28 target.

Thanks — happy to walk through any control-specific excerpts.

Jonas Weber
Director, Applied Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
